regions.note: Clean sample of the floor ground: matte steel blue-grey enamel over the faint hazard-yellow floor-tape grid, no ink on it. Page tiles this as the base material; the visible band A5:J8 and the empty floor inside every station panel are the same material.
Riveted steel header bar: stencil wordmark UGC FACTORY, subtitle, dot-matrix LED counter strip (BRIEFS/QUEUE/TAKT) on inset black, and the ARIA persona chip. All code-drawn.
Station 01 INTAKE panel: enamel body with corner bolt heads, stencil numeral 01, andon lamp. Code-drawn.
9:16 phone viewport: inset black screen with notch, red pulsing REC dot, and caption bar. Code-drawn, no imagery.
REEL TRANSCRIPT textarea and the WHY IT FITS THIS PERSONA input plate, with monospace labels. Code-drawn form controls.
Station 02 ANALYZER panel: enamel body, bolts, stencil numeral 02, andon lamp. Code-drawn.
Hook card: PATTERN-INTERRUPT chip on a bordered inset plate. Code-drawn.
Three-row beat timeline with amber mono timestamps (0:00-0:03 hook, 0:03-0:18 setup, 0:18-0:28 payoff). Code-drawn.
Diagonal red REMIX rubber stamp, double-ruled border, rotated. Code-drawn, not a raster stamp image.
Station 03 STYLIST panel: enamel body, bolts, stencil numeral 03, andon lamp. Code-drawn.

Three garment thumbnail placeholder cells (dress, gold, heels) each with a green/amber formality meter bar. Flat placeholder fills, code-drawn; real garment photos drop in here later as image regions.
MDEP chips playful / casual / mall in amber mono. Code-drawn.
Station 04 EXPRESSION panel: enamel body, bolts, stencil numeral 04, andon lamp. Code-drawn.
Rotary expression dial: knurled rim, cap, amber indicator needle, mischievous_grin label. Code-drawn, no raster dial.
GENUINE (green, lit) and PERFORMED (dark) andon status lamps. Code-drawn.
Station 05 DISPATCH panel: enamel body, bolts, stencil numeral 05, andon lamp. Code-drawn.
Cream paper job ticket with torn top edge, PERSONA/HOOK/SCRIPT/EXPRESSION/CAPTION print, and a red REMIX stamp. Flat cream fill + code-drawn type and stamp; no paper-grain raster.
Horizontal steel conveyor beam crossing the full width with the glowing amber job token riding it. Code-drawn.
Bottom control deck: four knurled MDEP dials (MOOD/DAY/ENVIRONMENT/PLACE) with amber needles and labels, hazard-tape top edge, green mono readout strip, and the amber RUN LINE button. All code-drawn.
